text:
laura: quick proposal after today's support spike: add an explicit per-service binding layer in SDKs + console so apps stop relying on ambiguous env shadowing. saw a customer rotate project keys and their background jobs kept using the org key.

ben: do you mean something like REDWOOD_BINDING_<SERVICE>=<key>? that would avoid guessing which key a process should use.

laura: exactly. SDKs would accept an optional serviceName when creating clients and prefer the binding if present. fallback order would be: service-specific binding -> REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY.

omar: sounds promising. what about existing apps that set both envs today? we need a migration plan.

laura: proposed rollout:
1) short-term: emit a clear startup warning when multiple generic keys present and log which key was chosen. telemetry event `credential.shadow_detected` emitted.
2) next: add REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT opt-in env var across SDKs (safe toggle).
3) then: ship per-service binding support in SDKs + console (opt-in) so ops can bind routes without code changes for many infra platforms.
4) 6-8 weeks later: flip default precedence to project-first and provide console-assisted migration.

zoe: can we make bindings work without code change? e.g., SDK checks RW_SERVICE env var and uses that to look up REDWOOD_BINDING_<RW_SERVICE>. Many customers set process/service names in env already.

ben: that helps, but for library users we should also expose client opt-in config `serviceName`. default the SDK to check RW_SERVICE env var if present.

infra-bot: Created ticket devex/sdk-credentials#4410: "Service bindings + migration plan: warnings, PREF_PROJECT toggle, bindings, console migration UX" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/4410)

omar: rotation behavior for long-lived streams is a concern. we should invalidate in-memory creds on SIGHUP or provide a refresh hook so ops can rotate without restarting.

laura: agreed. add SIGHUP cache flush and ensure reconnect re-runs discovery and checks bindings/flags. will add e2e that rotates a project key mid-stream and asserts the reconnect uses the rotated key.

zoe: telemetry plan: emit `credential.shadow_detected` with counts, `credential.binding_used` when a binding is present, and `credential.rotate_reconnect` when a reconnect succeeds with a rotated key. helps us decide when to flip default.

ben: for console UX: show a per-route binding panel with quick bind/unbind and migration preview (simulate traffic using old vs new binding). product can show an opt-in banner linking to migration CLI.

omar: CLI helper idea: `rw keys audit` to scan env manifests and k8s configs for multiple keys, then `rw keys migrate --bind <route> --to project` or `--set-pref=project`. low friction for infra teams.

laura: I'll draft the CLI subcommands. also add a short faq for rotation semantics and a sample SIGHUP handler.

zoe: SDK parity: prioritize JS and Go first (most reported cases), then Rust/Python. keep REDWOOD_PREFER_PROJECT opt-in until telemetry looks healthy. add unit tests for reconnect semantics.

ben: small short-term change: sampleapp should log which key it uses at startup and warn when both present. that will reduce support noise immediately.

laura: will open a tiny PR to sampleapps for the warning and SIGHUP handler example. will link here.

infra-bot: Linked PR sampleapps#702 (draft) and created project board column "cred migrations".

omar: timeline suggestion: warnings + telemetry this week, PREF_PROJECT opt-in next week, bindings & console flow in 3 weeks, flip default after 6 weeks if telemetry OK.

laura: agreed. assigning tasks: ben -> console UI, omar -> CLI, zoe -> telemetry + e2e, laura -> sampleapp PR + comms. I'll post a one-pager to #product and schedule a 20-min sync.

ben: thanks. small ask: include a short blurb for support with example troubleshooting steps for rotation issues (how to detect shadowing, how to force project key).

laura: will include that in the playbook. thanks team. :rocket:
